reasons.PAYEE_REPORTED: This UPI ID has been reported for fraud.
reasons.PAYEE_NEAR_REPORTED: Money sent to this UPI ID is quickly passed on to an account reported for fraud.
reasons.PAYEE_PASSTHROUGH: This UPI ID forwards almost everything it receives within minutes.
reasons.REPORTED_AT_OTHER_BANK: This UPI ID has been reported by customers of another bank.
reasons.CALL_ACTIVE_UNKNOWN: You are on a call with a number that is not in your contacts.
reasons.CALLER_FLAGGED: The number that called you {mins_since_call} minutes ago is flagged for fraud.
reasons.CALLER_FLAGGED.active: The number you are on a call with is flagged for fraud.
reasons.MESSAGE_FLAGGED: You recently received a message that looks like a scam.
reasons.PAYEE_IN_SCAM_MESSAGE: This UPI ID appeared in a message you flagged as a scam.
reasons.AMOUNT_UNUSUAL: This is {amount_ratio} times larger than your usual payment.
reasons.AMOUNT_UNUSUAL.generic: This payment is unusual for your account.
reasons.BALANCE_DRAIN: This payment would use most of your balance.
reasons.DEVICE_CHANGED: You are paying from a device first used {device_age} ago.
reasons.DEVICE_CHANGED.new: You are paying from a device you have not used before.
reasons.RAPID_NEW_PAYEES: This is your {n} payment to a new UPI ID in 10 minutes.
reasons.VPA_PASTED: You pasted this UPI ID instead of choosing a saved contact.
reasons.APP_SWITCHING: You switched to another app {app_switch_count} times while making this payment.

DIGITAL_ARREST.name: Digital arrest
DIGITAL_ARREST.headline: This looks like a "digital arrest" scam
DIGITAL_ARREST.body: Police, CBI and courts never ask for money over UPI and never keep you on a call. Hang up. Call 1930.
DIGITAL_ARREST.tip: Police, CBI and courts never ask for money over UPI and never keep you on a call. Hang up and call 1930.
DIGITAL_ARREST.question: Is someone on a call telling you to make this payment?

FAKE_REFUND.name: Fake refund
FAKE_REFUND.headline: You are about to PAY money, not receive it
FAKE_REFUND.body: No one needs your UPI PIN or a payment from you to send you a refund.
FAKE_REFUND.tip: You never have to pay, scan a code or enter your UPI PIN to receive a refund.
FAKE_REFUND.question: Were you told this payment is needed to receive a refund?

MULE_TRANSFER.name: Mule transfer
MULE_TRANSFER.headline: This UPI ID is collecting money from many strangers
MULE_TRANSFER.body: It was created recently and many new people have paid it in the last hour.
MULE_TRANSFER.tip: A newly opened personal account that many strangers are suddenly paying is often collecting money for scammers. Pay an advance only to a seller you can check.
MULE_TRANSFER.question: Do you personally know the person you are paying?

network.headline: This UPI ID looks like a pass-through account
network.body: Accounts like this are opened to collect money and move it on quickly. Pay only if you know this person.

IMPERSONATION.name: Impersonation
IMPERSONATION.headline: Check this request with the person directly
IMPERSONATION.body: You have never paid this UPI ID before. Call them on a number you already have.
IMPERSONATION.tip: A boss, relative or friend writing from a new number and asking for money urgently: call them on the number you already have before you pay.
IMPERSONATION.question: Have you spoken to this person on a number you already had?

known.body: Call them on a number you already have before you pay.

KYC_BILL_THREAT.name: KYC or bill threat
KYC_BILL_THREAT.headline: Banks and electricity boards do not take payments this way
KYC_BILL_THREAT.body: Messages that threaten to block your account or cut your power unless you pay now are a common scam.
KYC_BILL_THREAT.tip: Banks and electricity boards do not threaten to cut you off unless you pay a personal UPI ID right now.
KYC_BILL_THREAT.question: Did a message or call threaten to block your account or cut a service?

INVESTMENT_TASK.name: Investment or task scam
INVESTMENT_TASK.headline: Guaranteed returns are a warning sign
INVESTMENT_TASK.body: Scammers pay small amounts first, then ask for larger "deposits" you never get back.
INVESTMENT_TASK.tip: Guaranteed returns and paid "tasks" are bait. Scammers pay small amounts first, then ask for larger deposits you never get back.
INVESTMENT_TASK.question: Were you promised a return or reward for making this payment?

UNCLASSIFIED.name: Unusual payment
UNCLASSIFIED.headline: This payment looks unusual
UNCLASSIFIED.body: Take a moment to check who you are paying and why.
UNCLASSIFIED.tip: Take a moment to check who you are paying and why.
UNCLASSIFIED.question: Did someone you have not met in person ask you to make this payment?

band_reasons.fan_in: Many new people have paid this recently
band_reasons.near_miss: Several people cancelled payments to this UPI ID

SCAM: Do not reply, click links or call numbers in this message.
Do not pay anyone it mentions.
If you already paid, call 1930 now.
CAREFUL: Check with the organisation using a number from their official website or app.
Do not share any code or PIN.
FINE: We did not find signs of a scam. Stay careful with any request for money or codes.

flags.urgency: Pressure to act fast is a common scam tactic.
flags.authority: Real authorities do not contact you this way.
flags.threat: Threats are used to stop you thinking.
flags.refund_bait: You never need to pay to receive money.
flags.secrets: No one legitimate asks for your PIN or code.
flags.secrecy: Being told to keep it secret is a warning sign.
flags.link: Shortened links hide where they really go.
